fullPassage: By enhancing energy efficiency and putting waste products to use, biopower helps move utilities and industries in a sustainable direction. The U.S. forest products industry now obtains half its energy by combusting woody waste and liquid waste from pulp mill processing. Biopower helps alleviate climate change as well by reducing carbon dioxide emissions, and capturing landfill gas reduces emissions of methane, a potent greenhouse gas. Biopower also benefits human health as it cuts down on pollution; by replacing coal in co-firing and direct combustion, biopower reduces emissions of sulfur dioxide because plant matter, unlike coal, contains no appreciable sulfur content. When plant matter is burned for power, soil is deprived of nutrients and organic matter it would have gained from the plant matter's decomposition. In addition, biomass resources tend to be geographically spread out, so using them can help support rural economies and reduce many nations' dependence on imported fuels.

questions.passage: By ①<u>enhance</u> energy efficiency and putting waste products to use, biopower helps move utilities and industries in a sustainable direction. The U.S. forest products industry now ②<u>obtains</u> half its energy by combusting woody waste. Biopower helps ③<u>alleviate</u> climate change by ④<u>reducing</u> carbon dioxide emissions.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: By enhancing (전치사 by + 동명사). enhance → enhancing.
det.analysis:
❌① enhance → enhancing: by + ~ing
✅② obtains: 3인칭 단수
✅③ alleviate: helps + 동사원형
✅④ reducing: by + ~ing
det.tip: by + 동명사: by enhancing = ~을 향상시킴으로써

questions.passage: Biopower also benefits human health as it cuts down on pollution; by replacing coal in co-firing and direct combustion, biopower reduces emissions of sulfur dioxide because plant matter, ①<u>unlike</u> coal, ②<u>contains</u> no ③<u>appreciable</u> sulfur content. When plant matter is ④<u>burning</u> for power, soil is deprived of nutrients.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: When plant matter is burned (수동태). burning → burned.
det.analysis:
❌④ burning → burned: 식물이 태워지는 것(수동)
✅① unlike: 전치사(~와 달리)
✅② contains: 3인칭 단수
✅③ appreciable: 형용사(수식)
det.tip: is burned = 수동태 (식물이 태워지다)

In addition, biomass resources tend to be geographically ③<u>spreading</u> out, so using them can help support rural economies and reduce many nations' ④<u>dependence</u> on imported fuels.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: tend to be spread out. 수동 의미(퍼져 있다). spreading → spread.
det.analysis:
❌③ spreading → spread: tend to be spread out (수동/상태)
✅① it: organic matter를 선행사로 하는 관계대명사절의 주어
✅② gained: would have gained (가정법 과거완료)
✅④ dependence: 명사
det.tip: be spread out = 퍼져 있다 (수동/상태 표현)
